pr_title: AJ-1026: create CM-API endpoint to get count of CRM Lite customers

comments.body:
Don't need the `.ConfigureAwait(false)` call here. 

See https://git.campmon.com/crews/c-sharp/blob/master/CodingGuidelines/AsyncCodeAndConfigureAwait.MD

PK is unique, don't need the `distinct` here. 
Plus we don't have single subscriber on multiple lists in CM, it would break our current contact model.
Use `sqlDataAccess.QuerySingleAsync` to avoid the `.Sum(x => (int)x);` at the end.

```suggestion
        logEx(ex, 'Failed to get CRM customer count', {clientId});
```

Should probably improve the type definition [js crew work]

I don't think we need to put this here in AudienceUserData provider. 

We don't need to grab crm customer count data for every single user using CM. (and we don't want an extra 50k db queries per hour for no use)

You can implement the fetch call as close to where it's actually used as possible - in this case in `CrmLiteSideBar.tsx`

I missed this in the previous review. 

Can you catch this please. 
This is gonna get a 502 for the majority of the time because most clients won't have crmlite enabled.
